cards.review_notes: Confirm VBS dates, hours, theme, eligibility and registration on the church's Facebook or Gibbs Kids page. Dates and hours were found only in third-party search listings at https://www.newsbreak.com/event/6a0f3a0a55a855d51cae386c-road-trip-vacation-bible-school-gibbs-chapel-wesleyan-church and https://happeningnext.com/event/road-trip-vacation-bible-school-gibbs-chapel-wesleyan-church-eid3a0do0xh03. HappeningNext explicitly labels the event 2026. The listings include a June 14 kickoff at 15:00 where parents are asked to stay; that family-only portion is omitted from the camp dates. The church's official kids page confirms the location.
